bundle.text:
# Register the Qoder provider without changing the profile's default model.
# PAT is configured in the plugin's settings card (or via environment
# variable); no OAuth flow is started by the plugin itself.
#
# `id` deliberately stays the unscoped `dsh-connect-qoder`: it is the entry id,
# the settings namespace (`settingsNamespaceOf`), and the `/plugins/<id>/…`
# route prefix. Renaming it would silently orphan every existing install's
# saved config. Only `name` — the package resolved through the profile's
# node_modules — carries the npm scope.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-connect-qoder
      name: '@dmh2002/dsh-connect-qoder'

readme.text:
dsh-connect-qoder

把 Qoder（通义灵码国内版 / 国际版）的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供账号池、每日签到、积分读数与模型管理。
English · 安装 · 工作原理 · 配置 · 账号池 · 更新日志 · 问题反馈

一个独立的 [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) bundle 插件。它把 Qoder 账号的模型接到 DSH 的模型选择器，同时提供模型管理与只读的用量概览。**国内版与国际版是两个并行的供应商（`qoder` / `qoder-global`），可同时使用**；插件的设置页以 tab 区分两者，方便统一管理。

> Qoder 官方不提供 OpenAI 兼容端点（其官方 SDK 只是 agent 启动器），因此本插件直连 Qoder 的 cosy 网关，实现了协议的最小客户端，无需在 Qoder 桌面端登录——只需一个 PAT（Personal Access Token）。

- **双供应商并行接入（国内版 + 国际版）** —— 国内版注册为 `qoder` provider（`gateway.qoder.com.cn`），国际版注册为 `qoder-global` provider（`api1.qoder.sh`）。**配置了 PAT 的区域其模型会出现在 DSH 模型选择器里**：两个区域都有 PAT 时两组同时可选，不同会话可以各选一边，互不干扰。**没有 PAT 的区域不列出任何模型**（一个请求也发不出去，列出来只会点到就失败）；配置 PAT 后「刷新模型」即可让模型自动出现——provider 本身始终注册着，配置入口在「设置 → Qoder」。模型名内嵌上游积分倍率（如 `Qwen3.8-Flash · x0.00`），与 Qoder 自身模型菜单一致。

- **设置页自成一处** —— 配置界面是 DSH 设置面板左侧导航里的独立一页（**设置 → Qoder**），与「账号与余额 / 通用设置 / 模型 / 插件」并列，不再藏在插件市场的插件详情页里。页面自上而下是：标题 → 一句话总述 → 三条核心用途 → 正文。 - **双 tab 切换** —— 页面顶部为「国内版 / 国际版」两个 tab，各含独立的 PAT、模型管理与用量概览；每个 tab 的目录、勾选与状态完全隔离。 - **正文按「账号 / 模型 / 诊断」分栏** —— 每个区域 tab 之下再把正文分成三栏。账号栏是账号池、积分读数开关与关于凭据的每一条说明（点一下即生效）；模型栏是勾选、上下文档位、思考强度与逐模型测试（草稿，点「保存」才落地）——两者的提交语义本来就不同，分开之后保存按钮就挨着它保存的东西。**切栏不重新拉取、不丢未保存的草稿**（非活动栏仍挂载）。诊断栏是一张只读的事实表：区域、**上游域名**（与真正发请求的主机名同一处事实）、服务账号、凭据来源、积分读取时刻、目录模型数、已启用数、账号池开关，以及上游最近一次错误的**原文**——它存在的唯一理由是被整段贴进问题反馈，所以里面没有任何会改设置的控件。 - **可单独关闭任一版本供应商** —— 每个 tab 右侧有一个勾选框（默认都勾选）。**取消勾选即把该供应商从 DSH 模型选择器里彻底撤掉**（不是只藏起 tab）：它的路由与「设置 → 模型」页的目录条目一并摘除。PAT、用量与勾选**全部保留**，重新勾选即完整恢复。注意：若某会话此前选中的正是被关闭供应商的模型，该会话再调用会报 `NO_ADAPTER`。 - **模型管理** —— 从上游刷新完整模型目录，逐项勾选启用或禁用；模型行显示倍率（`(0.50x)`）、上下文/输出上限、思考强度档位与免费标记，行右有「图片」「可关闭思考」开关、上下文档位选择器与「测试」按钮。勾选状态写入本地配置，立即同步到模型选择器。**目录里有几个模型就排几行，列表自己不设高度上限、不出内滚动条**——这条列表的用途是「看见并勾选模型」，只露七八行、把其余的藏进第二条滚动条（面板本身已经在滚）会让「有这个模型吗」变成一个需要先发现、再去拖的动作；要看全就滚页面。**上游的 `auto` 不列出来**：它是该区的默认**路由**，网关在请求时才决定把它解析成哪个模型，所以价格与上下文都由别人临时决定，插件无法如实描述——它不是模型，不该占一行让你勾选。

- **活动优惠徽标** —— 上游在模型目录里自带活动规则（`promotion`：文案、时段、时区），模型行就在名字旁画一枚小胶囊，如「错峰 4 折」。**文案原样来自上游**（中文界面取 `badge.zh`，英文界面取 `badge.en`），插件不翻译也不改写；悬停给出上游的说明、时段与时区，以及活动文档链接原文。什么时候画由**渲染时刻**决定：有上游声明的墙钟时段（支持跨零点、按上游时区算）就按时段现算，没有时段才退回上游的 `active`——所以夜里读到的目录不会把徽标冻结到第二天早上，早上启动的进程也不会因此整晚不显示；没有活动字段的模型什么都不画。同一枚徽标也画在宿主的**模型选择器**里（`conversation.input.model.label` 槽位，issue #12）——选择器才是做选择的地方，与卡片共用同一套判定、文案与样式。取证与判定规则见 [docs/PROMO_BADGE.md](docs/PROMO_BADGE.md)。

- **模型可用性测试** —— 每个模型行有一个「测试」按钮，直达上游确认该模型此刻能否使用：限流（429）报「被限流」、凭据无效报「凭据无效」、内容审核拒绝报「内容被审核拒绝」、额度耗尽报「额度已耗尽」，其余上游瞬时故障如实分类。探测在后台发起，**凭据不会传到页面**；结果不写入设置，也不改变你已保存的勾选。**它发的是真实请求**（会消耗少量上游额度），因此只能按单个模型手工点，没有「测试已勾选」这类批量按钮。 - **每日签到** —— Qoder 有官方每日签到活动（个人用户每天可领 100 Credits，30 天有效）。账号池提供「一键签到所有账号」：逐账号领取、已领过的按幂等处理（不重复领取、不算失败），签到后积分自动刷新。国内版与国际版都已接通（国际版需要本机 Qoder 客户端的设备风控组件，取不到时如实报错而不是假装「今天没有活动」）。 - **活动（只读，可关）** —— 卡片在区域作用域内、额度读数之下是一组**活动瓦片**，逐条列出上游当前下发的活动：每日 100 Credits 签到行（带额度与「可领取 / 已领取」状态）与「1024 创造力集结」「首月订阅 Credits 翻倍」这类 banner（`VIEW_DETAILS`）。瓦片按栏宽自动排两列（`auto-fill` + 260px 下限），描述限两行、全文在悬停里，状态与「查看详情」贴底对齐；上游下发的活动条数不多时它们并排而不是各占一行，`612px` 的正文栏里三条活动约占 180px。**每个区域可以单独关掉**（设置页的「显示活动」，默认开，`regions..showCampaigns`；关掉后这一页直接从 tab 栏开始，不发那条 `/campaigns` 请求）。**标题与描述原样来自上游**（按界面语言取 `zh` / `en`，缺哪边用另一边），「查看详情」是真正的链接（上游的 `detailUrl`，缺失时退回活动落地页）；**只读**，不签到、不改账号。上游没下发就显示「当前没有活动」，读不到则显示原因（不是装作没有）。此前本插件只读签到用的那一小片活动数据，banner 行被整行跳过（用户实拍 2026-10-25），现已整份读取。 - **积分（只读）** —— 账号池逐账号显示剩余积分、**积分何时作废**与**套餐何时到期**（来自 Qoder 的 `sash/api/v2/me/usage`，凭 `jt-

- **命令行诊断与现场验证** —— `dsh-connect-qoder doctor|status|logout [--json] [--region cn|global]`：`doctor` 报 PAT 来源、cosy 指纹派生、pi-ai 代际、宿主心跳存活与 vault 账号计数；`status` 报凭据来源、上游可达性与当前剩余积分；`logout` 清除指定区域的 vault 账号与账号池测量副本。另有 `pnpm run probe:cosy`（不依赖宿主直连 cosy 链路验证）与 `pnpm run probe:vault`（只读 dump vault / 账号池测量，PAT 只显示掩码）。

```text
DSH PiAiAdapter（每个 provider 一套）
  -> 安全 loopback shim（每区域一个随机端口 + 进程内随机 secret）
  -> QoderUpstreamClient（cosy 协议最小客户端）
  -> 国内版 https://gateway.qoder.com.cn/algo/api/v2/...

国内版与国际版各持一套完整的运行时栈——上游客户端、模型 catalog、回环 shim、adapter——按区域配置（网关 / openapi / 目录路径）隔离，所以**两个区域的模型可以同时可选、被不同会话使用**。

凭据是 PAT（设置页 `regions.<region>.pat` 或环境变量，见[配置](#配置)），设置项优先。每次会话按需惰性交换 **jobToken**：PAT 只在这个交换请求里使用一次，之后的对外请求全部携带 cosy bearer（自定义 Base64 载荷 + MD5 签名）与「机器指纹」会话头。**PAT 从不进入 pi-ai，也从不外发到网关之外；本插件不读不写 Qoder 桌面端的本地登录文件。**

模型的 cosy 编码与签名细节（自定义字母表、`n/3` 重排、`cosy&<SECRET>&<date>` 签名、RSA/AES 会话封装）见 `src/cosy.ts` 的头部注释；错误分类（内容审核 / 限流 / 额度耗尽 / 瞬时故障）与 DSH 重试语义的对应见 `src/upstream.ts`。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @dmh2002/dsh-connect-qoder   # Desktop
dsh plugin --profile web add @dmh2002/dsh-connect-qoder       # Web
```

装完**重启该 profile 的 DSH 进程**（bundle 的 host 半边在启动时加载）。也可以在 DSH 的「插件市场 / Bundles」里搜 `dsh-connect-qoder` 一键安装。

> **`dsh` 命令报 `Cannot find module .../DSH NEXT.app/...`？** 那是宿主换代留下的旧 shim：宿主 app 目录名已从 `DSH NEXT.app` 变为 `DeepSeek Harness.app`，而 `~/.local/bin/dsh` 仍指向被移除的旧路径。把 shim 改指新宿主自带的 CLI 入口即可：
>
> ```bash
> exec "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" "$@"
> ```
>
> 新入口内部以 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` 运行 `app.asar` 里的 `dsh/lib/bin.js`，profile 仍由 `--profile` 决定。

> npm 包名带 `@dmh2002/` 作用域。插件在 DSH 内的**配置标识不带作用域**——设置命名空间、`/plugins/dsh-connect-qoder/…` 路由与命令行程序名都仍是 `dsh-connect-qoder`，所以 0.2.0 之前装过的用户升级后配置照旧生效，不用重填 PAT。设置页的寻址也不再依赖包名：它是 `settings.section`，键是**不带作用域**的 entry id。但**浏览器 bundle 的模块 id、模型选择器标签与「设置」按钮退回插件市场时用的包名**仍按带作用域的包名建，这几处由构建期从 `package.json` 注入，改包名不会漏下它们。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/dingminhua/dsh-connect-qoder.git
cd dsh-connect-qoder
pnpm install
pnpm run check        # typecheck + test + build 全绿后再安装

以 `link:` 安装进当前 profile，改码后重启 DSH 即生效（不会重装依赖树）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /Users/dmh2002/DshProject/dsh-connect-qoder
```

- 打开「设置」（侧边栏那颗齿轮，或 `Cmd/Ctrl + ,`）→ 左侧导航最下方的 **Qoder** → 应看到配置页（国内版 / 国际版两个 tab）。
- 在该 profile 目录里 `pnpm exec dsh-connect-qoder doctor` 应输出两个区域的 PAT 状态与指纹派生。
- 配置 PAT 后，「从 Qoder 刷新」应拉出该区域的真实模型清单；模型选择器出现 `Qoder` / `Qoder Global` 两个分组。

在 Qoder 账户设置里创建 PAT（`pt-…` 开头）。两种提供方式，**设置页优先于环境变量**：

| 区域 | 发证入口 | 设置项 | 环境变量 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 国内版（qoder.com.cn） | 控制台 → 设置 → API 令牌 | 卡片「国内版」tab → 添加 PAT | `QODERCN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN` |
| 国际版（qoder.sh） | 控制台 → Settings → Personal Access Tokens | 卡片「国际版」tab → 添加 PAT | `QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN` |

- PAT 只保存到本地插件配置（`regions.<region>.pat`），从不上传、不进入任何网络请求。
- 未配置 PAT 的区域不列出任何模型；`doctor` 命令会指出哪个区域缺 PAT。
- **逐步操作说明见 [`docs/PAT.md`](docs/PAT.md)**（含创建流程、验证机制、优先级与常见问题）。
卡片每个 tab 右侧的勾选框控制该区域是否参与模型选择（opt-out：**显式取消勾选才停用**）。停用只摘除路由与目录条目，配置全部保留。

readme.section: 侧边栏面板（可选，默认关闭）
readme.text: 卡片「账号」栏里有一行「在侧边栏显示 Qoder」：勾上之后，DSH 侧边栏会多一个 Qoder 图标行，点开就是**这张卡片的整页版**（同样的账号池、模型目录、诊断栏，只是占满中央那一列），页头带一个「返回会话」。

readme.section: 侧边栏面板（可选，默认关闭）
readme.text:
- **默认关闭，且是一次显式的 opt-in**。这一行占的是 `sidebar.panellist` —— **所有插件共用的全局侧边栏座位**，点开还会接管中央面板，所以打开它是对你整个侧边栏的决定，不是对这张卡片的偏好。「插件」页本来就能看到同一张卡片，所以没主动勾过的人**升级后界面不会有任何变化**。
- **点一下即生效，不用保存**。关掉时如果整页正开着，中央那一列会自动回到对话（宿主会丢掉 `main` key 已不存在的那次选中）。
- 存为顶层配置项 `sidebarPanel`（**没有区域轴**：侧边栏只有一行、一个整页，与国内版/国际版无关）。所以某一区域签出、甚至两个区域都关掉时它仍可打开——面板本身就是你去添加第一个 PAT 的地方之一。
- 判据是 `=== true`：缺席、`false`、以及被手工改成字符串 `"true"` 的垃圾值，一律读作关闭。
除设置 PAT 与环境变量外，每区域还有一个本地 vault（`$DSH_HOME/.qoder-accounts.<region>.json`，权限 0600）保存多个 PAT 账号。三源按 **settings → env → vault** 的优先级去重合并（同一个 PAT 只在最高优先级的来源里列出一次）。

- 卡片可新增（粘贴 `pt-…`，经 `JobToken` 交换校验并取回显示名，也可自填备注名）/ 改名 vault 账号，也可显式选择某一账号服务（`regions.<region>.accountId`，留空自动）。删除 vault 账号在池表格的行内「删除」按钮（需二次确认）；取消勾选并保存只是把它移出轮换，PAT 仍留在本地。
- 选中的凭据只用于会话的 jobToken 交换与后续 cosy 请求，从不进入 pi-ai 或页面。
- `logout [--region cn|global]` 会清除指定区域的 vault 账号与账号池测量副本（`$DSH_HOME/.qoder-accounts.<region>.json` 与 `.qoder-pool.<region>.json`）。
- 勾选成员、一键签到、一键测试与自动换号的规则见[账号池](#账号池)。

一台机器上往往有多个 Qoder 账号（多个 PAT）。**账号池**把这些账号收成一次点击：勾进池子，然后「一键签到所有账号」或「一键测试所有账号」；再打开**启用账号池**，插件就会在请求失败时自动换号接着跑。

**每个区域（国内版 / 国际版）各有独立的一池**：成员、目标模型、积分与签到状态互不影响——两边的账号本来就属于不同的供应商。**两个区域都有每日签到**：国际版的签到活动只下发给带设备风控头的请求，插件按区域读取本机 Qoder 客户端自带的设备身份组件；取不到时如实报错，不会把「拿不到设备身份」伪装成「今天没有活动」。

readme.section: 自动换号（开启账号池即生效）
readme.text:
- **谁来服务由排序决定**：开启后**每一次请求**都发给池内排序最靠前的可用账号，所以「当前使用」显示的是排序的结果，不一定是你手动选的那个。
- **失败时继续往下试**：某个请求在上游失败时，插件**依次**用池内其他可用账号重试，直到有一个接手、或全部不可用为止才把错误报出来。
- **哪些失败会换号**：429 限流、额度耗尽、401/403 凭据被拒、5xx 网关与网络故障——这些都是**某个账号**的状态，换一个很可能就过了。
- **哪些不会**：请求本身不合法（HTTP 400）——同一个请求体换谁都是同样的 400，重试只是让你多等几轮；**流已开始之后**也不会重放（字节已经发出去了）。
- **已知不可用的账号会被跳过**：处于限流冷却期内、或凭据已被上游拒绝的成员不参与选择。**从没测过的账号按「默认可用」参与**——刚添加的账号不该因为「还没测」就被排除。
- **手动选择从不被改写**：池子通过运行时覆盖决定「谁服务」，**不写回你保存的选择**；关掉开关，你选定的账号立刻完全生效。
- **失败会被记下来**：一次失败会写成该账号的测量（含上游报文中给出的恢复时间），下一个请求直接从可用账号开始，不必每次先撞一遍同一个限流账号。
- **换号会告诉你**：换号是插件替你做的决定，所以它会说出来——回答开头带一条引用块提示，例如 `> [dsh-connect-qoder] 「450702134816」被限流，已改用池中另一个账号回答。`。提示说的是**失败的那个账号**（你选中的那个），不点名接管者；连换多次只写一条，说的是紧邻换号的那次失败。没换号就一个字都不写。

readme.section: 这个开关到底控制什么
readme.text:
**它只控制「插件要不要自己决定」，不控制「你能不能操作」。**

| | 账号池 **开启** | 账号池 **关闭** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 谁服务 | 由排序**自动**选出（可用优先 → 积分快过期 → 积分到期最近 → 积分高 → id） | **你**在设置区的「使用哪个账号」里选定 |
| 请求失败 | **自动**换下一个可用账号重试 | 不换号，如实报错 |
| 一键签到 / 一键测试 | 可用 | **仍然可用** |
| 目标测试模型 | 可改 | **仍然可改** |

最后两行是刻意的：签到与测试是**手动动作**，作用于你勾选的成员，与「插件是否自动路由」是两件事。

**唯一的硬约束**：池里一个成员都没勾选时，批量动作一律拒绝。空的池**绝不**退化成「那就对全部账号执行」——那是唯一会花掉你没授权过的积分的解读。

宿主有一个「原地重试」环：一次请求失败但值得再试时，它等一小段时间再发一次。等待阶梯由插件声明、宿主执行，默认跟随宿主（不填就是宿主的默认值，升级不会改变你现在的行为）。

Qoder 上游偶尔会回 `RESOURCE_LIMIT`（业务码 `10605`）并**自己申报**「请等 N 秒再来」。插件现在会把这个值写进给宿主的失败文案（形如 `[upstream retry-after 5s]`），你能直接看出上游只要求等多久，而不是只看到「上游报了个 4xx」。

想改预算就配这三个数字（都在区域级，两个区域各配各的）：

```yaml
regions:
  cn:
    retry:
      maxRetries: 4        # 最多重试几次（0 = 跟随宿主默认）

上面的 `5000 → 30000` 兼顾了上游两种常见形态：瞬时限流（申报 5 秒）与 `queueType:p2` 排队（约 30 秒）。**前三个 0 表示跟随宿主默认**，所以留空与不写这个配置等价；第四个 `queueWaitMs` 的 0 则是**关掉**（见下节）。
> 此前这一项只能是宿主的默认值，想调就得改 `node_modules` 里的构建产物 —— 而那会在升级时静默还原。

**重试预算管不到「上游明确要求等 30 秒」的情形。** 宿主的阶梯是递增的（5s → 10s → 20s → 30s，带抖动），前两次**一定**短于上游申报的 30 秒；实测一轮 28 次重试、纯等待 296 秒，其中 11 次是在上游说「等 30 秒」之后 5 秒内就重发的。

插件无法让宿主精确等待：`pi-ai` 那条路由没有 `providerRetryAfterMs` 通道（issue #24 已复核，`retry-after` 在该模块与底层 vendor 里都不解析）。所以在转发层自己等掉，是唯一能让「等 30 秒」真的等于 30 秒、又不必消耗宿主重试预算的办法：

- 上游回 `isQueued: true` 并申报了等待秒数，且该值 **≤ `queueWaitMs`** ⇒ 插件等满这个时长再重发一次，这次失败**不交给宿主**；
- 申报值超过上限、或重发后仍排队 ⇒ 原样交回宿主，此时它至少还有剩余预算；
- 每个请求**只等一次**，等待可中断（你点停止就立刻停）；
- 配 `queueWaitMs: 0` 关掉，行为回到「全靠宿主的阶梯」。

同一个 `isQueued: true` 有两种形态，插件的措辞与账号池的处理不同：

| 上游字段 | 含义 | 插件怎么处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isQueued:true` + `serviceAvailable:true` | 服务是好的，你排在队里（`queueCount` 通常 > 0） | 记为 **排队中**，按上游申报的时长冷却，换号有意义 |
| `isQueued:true` + `serviceAvailable:false` | 上游**整体**在拒服务（实测 `queueCount: 0`，队列里一个人都没有） | 记为 **上游整体不可用**，换号提示明说「不是该账号的问题」 |

区别很重要：前者「等一会儿/换个账号」有效；后者换号、**换 PAT 都没用** —— 现场 14 个模型同时不可用。此前两种情况都被压成「排队中」，用户会以为自己的凭据坏了而去重配。

readme.section: 排序规则（开启账号池后决定谁服务）
readme.text:
1. **可用优先** —— 被测量判定为不可用（限流未到恢复时间、凭据被拒等）的排到最后；
2. **有临期积分的优先** —— 3 天内到期的先花，过期即作废（临期判定优先于下面第 3 条的用户手排顺序，见 `rankPool` 的注释）；
3. **用户手排的顺序优先**（`orderAccountIds`）—— 拖出来的顺序要真的生效，否则拖了也没用；
4. **积分到期最近 → 临期金额大 → 积分高** —— 只在有**新鲜读数**时参与（卡片轮询、批量测试或保存时读到的那份，10 分钟内有效）：请求路径**不会**为了排序去打上游，否则一页对话就变成 N 个额外请求；
5. 最后按账号 id 收尾，保证顺序是**全序**、可复现。

⚠️ **套餐到期不参与排序**（issue #31）：那个日期说的是「账号还能用多久」，与「手上的分会不会作废」是两件事。把它当临期紧急度会让一个刚过试用期的号永远排在最前面 —— 而它的分一分都不会过期。

- **一键签到所有账号** —— 逐个账号领取当日的官方签到活动。**先查状态再领取**，已领过的直接标「已签到」而**不发写入请求**（幂等，不重复领取）；任何单个账号失败只标记该行，**不中断整批**。签到会改变余额，因此批次结束后作废该区域的积分缓存，卡片不会继续显示领取前的数字。
- **一键测试所有账号** —— 对每个成员发一次真实请求，得出「这个账号此刻能不能用这个模型」。目标模型默认由「自动」挑本区域**倍率为 0 的免费模型**（多个候选取上下文窗口最大的），你也可以显式指定——但**在免费模型出现之前测试保持关闭**，避免在你不知情的情况下花掉积分。测试走的是与模型行同一套探测，因此**有真实成本**。

**「测试用模型」不受「已启用模型」影响**（issue #33）：勾选管的是 DSH 的模型选择器里列哪些模型，不是「允许测哪些」。卡片上写着哪个模型、测试就测哪个——哪怕它没有被勾进「已启用模型」，哪怕「自动」档唯一的免费模型没勾。这两份目录曾经分开过（卡片读完整目录、测试路由读裁剪过的运行时目录），结果就是按钮点了没反应：卡片写着「测试用模型 qfmodel」，点下去却是空结果。现在全插件只有一份目录。

真的**解不出**目标时（目录里一个免费模型都没有，或你手选的那个已下架），接口回 `409` + 原因（`no-free-model` / `target-model-stale`），卡片会直说「没有可测的目标模型」，而不是回一句像是账号坏了的「Host 未返回该账号的结果」。

两种批量动作都**不锁住界面**：按钮自己变成「签到中… / 测试中…」，每处理完一个账号，那一行立刻落位、活动日志也**逐条**写下（时间戳是各自完成的那一刻，不是整批结束的那一秒）；其余界面照常可用。只有**保存配置**与**删除账号**会挡一道——前者在写盘、后者不可逆。

设置页的排布：顶部是**两格独立的供应商卡片**（国内版 / 国际版），每格自带边框与底色、右端有自己的开关，选中的那格描品牌色边——**一格就是一个单位**，点名字切 tab、点开关启用该供应商。再往下是「在对话框显示积分」与「显示位置」两行（整行可点，主标题下一行是说明），第三行是**可选的「在侧边栏显示 Qoder」**，然后是账号池、模型管理。这三行都是**立即生效，不需要点保存**：前两行管积分读数显不显示、显示在哪里，第三行管侧边栏那一行（以及它打开的整页）在不在。

不提供**自动**签到：签到会真实领取奖励，只在你点按钮时执行。

readme.section: 上游没说「什么时候恢复」时，插件在做什么（issue #32）
readme.text:
有两件事长得很像，其实完全不同：

| | 意思 | 谁决定的 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `retryAtMs` 有值 | 「上游说这个时刻之后可以再用」 | 上游的字段、报文里的重置句，或按签到快照的当日窗口**推算**（`retrySource` 区分这几种） |
| `retrySource: 'unknown-cooldown'` | 「上游没说、快照也没有；我们在**按 30 分钟**自己重试」 | 插件 |

这两个状态以前在数据里分不开：`retryAtMs` 缺席时，卡片沉默，看起来与「上游没说、系统也不打算再试」一模一样 —— 而实际上池子每 30 分钟就会拿**一次真实聊天请求**再去撞一次。现在兜底分支会写下 `retrySource: 'unknown-cooldown'`，卡片那一格说「上游未给出何时恢复 · 每 30 分钟自动重试一次」。**它只写来源，不写 `retryAtMs`** —— 那个字段继续只放上游/推算给出的时刻，把本地节奏写进去会让下一处读者以为上游承诺过某个时间点。

readme.section: 上游没说「什么时候恢复」时，插件在做什么（issue #32）
readme.text: **30 分钟这个数刻意不动**：官方只说了「当日用量用尽后次日可继续」，没给具体时刻，编 6 小时与编 30 分钟性质相同。真正降低代价的是下面这条。

readme.section: 签到窗口时刻会落盘，重启后不再必然走兜底
readme.text:
`110`（当日用量限制）的恢复时刻来自签到活动行的 `endAt`。这份快照以前只在进程内 —— 而兜底冷却恰恰只在「窗口时刻不知道」时生效，于是**每次重启都让兜底必然生效**，一个要等次日窗口的号就被每 30 分钟试探一次。

现在签到成功的窗口时刻会写进 `$DSH_HOME/.qoder-pool.<region>.json` 的 `windows` 键，重启后照常读回（进程内快照优先，磁盘其次；**已经过去的时刻不采用** —— 拿旧日期当「下次恢复时刻」会把号判到很久以后才解禁）。这条改动让兜底从「经常生效」变成「几乎不生效」，比调那个 30 分钟有用得多。

在**已装本插件的 profile 目录里**跑（推荐，无需全局安装）：

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm exec dsh-connect-qoder doctor    # PAT 来源 + cosy 指纹派生 + pi-ai 代际 + 心跳 + vault 计数（纯本地，不发请求）
pnpm exec dsh-connect-qoder status    # 每区域凭据来源 + 上游模型目录可达性 + 剩余积分（需 PAT）
pnpm exec dsh-connect-qoder logout --region cn   # 清除指定区域的 vault 账号与账号池测量副本

`status` 会真实交换一次 jobToken 并拉取模型目录（随后只读查询一次用量），因此需要对应区域的环境变量或 vault PAT；`doctor` 完全离线。

> **两条实测过的注意事项**：
> 1. **别用 `node node_modules/dsh-connect-qoder/lib/bin.js` 这种裸路径**——0.3.0 起包名带作用域，软链在 `node_modules/@dmh2002/dsh-connect-qoder`，写旧路径只会得到 `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`（缺的是**入口文件**，不是 peer）。
> 2. CLI 依赖宿主提供的 peer 包（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write` / `dsh-home-paths`）。本机实测：pnpm 会随包把它们装进 profile 的依赖树，`pnpm exec` 与 npm 装的 tarball 都能跑通。但这**取决于 pnpm 版本与 `auto-install-peers` 配置**——如果在你机器上报 `Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-atomic-write'`，那是这一层没装上；设置页与 provider **不受影响**（它们在宿主进程内，宿主自己解析这些名字）。同族 workbuddy 的 issue #47 是同一个形状，其修复方案（宿主优先、按需回落自带实现）适用于本项目，尚未移植。

| 平台 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | ✅ 已验证（开发与 CI） |
| Windows | ✅ CI 测试通过（上游请求走标准 fetch，无平台专属路径） |
| Linux | ✅ CI 测试通过 |

> 范围由 `tests/dsh-line.spec.ts` 强制。DSH 至今只发预发布，而 node-semver 只有当范围里*某个*比较符与该版本的 `major.minor.patch` 元组完全一致、且自身也带预发布标签时，才会放行预发布版本。所以每开一条新线就得加一条分支：只写 `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` 会**静默排除整条 `0.2.0-rc.*`**（`0.2.0-rc.2` 曾是 `latest`），同理 `>=0.2.0-rc.1` 这一支**不含 `0.2.1-rc.1`**（桌面端 0.2.1-rc.1 已发布）。上界仍须带 `-0`（`<0.3.0` 不挡任何东西）。
>
> **两套语义并存**（1.1.2 实测更正）：npm / pnpm 安装走 node-semver **标准**语义，新补丁号的 rc（`0.2.2-rc.1` 已于 2026-11-05 补齐分支，下一个待补的是 `0.2.3-rc.1`）**确实**仍需手工追加一条分支 —— `UNGATED_PRERELEASES` 就是这份可见的待办表。但**宿主的插件兼容门禁不是标准语义**：`dsh-app-boot` 用 `semver.satisfies(v, range, { includePrerelease: true })`，在这个语义下 `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` 一支就覆盖**整条 `0.2.x` 线**（`0.2.2-rc.1`、`0.2.9` 都放行），`0.3.0-rc.1` 仍被上界拦住。1.1.0/1.1.1 曾断言「没有任何静态范围能覆盖任意 `0.2.x` 预发布」，那句话只对 npm 成立，对宿主门禁不成立，已更正。GA 版本（如 `0.2.1`）对既有分支本来就判 true。
>
> **pi-ai 单独列一行**是因为它换了主版本：0.2.1-rc.1 宿主把 pi-ai 从 0.85 换到 1.x，而两代的上下文契约不同（1.x 在 Models 层归一化）。声明与检测必须一致，否则就是 1.1.0 修掉的那个静默丢工具缺陷 —— 详见 [`docs/DSH-0.2.1-RC1-FOLLOWUP.md`](docs/DSH-0.2.1-RC1-FOLLOWUP.md)。
宿主升到 `0.2.2-rc.1`（`app.asar` 内 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 均为 `0.2.2-rc.1`，内置 pi-ai **`1.3.0`**、cordis `4.1.0`、schemastery `3.19.0`）。这一轮**需要适配**，与 0.2.1 线的「零改动」不同：

| 检查项 | 结论 |
| --- | --- |
| `ResolvedPiAiProviderProfile` | 新增必填 `maxRequestImages` / `imageOffloadCountQuantum`（单请求图片条数上限，宿主默认 50 / 10）。插件手工拼 profile，宿主的默认化不会跑 → 已显式补齐 |
| pi-ai 1.3.0 的 api 入参 | 改为品牌化的 `TranscriptContext`（只有 `normalizeContext()` 能产出）。只影响 legacy（0.85）回填分支，已在该分支边界加断言，并注明 1.3.0 宿主走不到这里 |
| `ctx.locale.register` | 签名加宽成 `Record<BuiltInLocaleId, …> & Record<LocaleId, …>`，实参需要 string 索引签名 → 已给 `QoderLocale` 加索引签名（双语仍合法，缺的语种按英文兜底） |
| peer 范围 | 补 `\|\| >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` 一支；在此之前 npm 标准语义判 false、宿主门禁一直判 true |
| modern 直通路径 | **无回归**：真实 1.3.0 栈上提示词与工具都在（modern fixture 升到 1.3.0 后 4 条直通用例全绿） |
| 中途 system 消息 | 0.2.2 起默认改写成 user 角色的 `<system-reminder>`（除非模型声明 `supportsMidConvoSystemMessages`）；Qoder 路由目前取默认 |
| 插件用到的槽位 / 事件 | `conversation.input.*`、`conversation.composer.dock`、`settings.section`、`plugins.*.config` 契约未变；`webserver/index-inject` 的 `peer` 参数与 `WebResourceRoute` 都是新增，插件不涉及 |
| 回归 | `pnpm run typecheck`（host + client 两套）与 `pnpm test` 全绿 |
> 0.2.1-rc.4 / rc.5 那一轮的逐条核查保留在 [`docs/DSH-0.2.1-RC1-FOLLOWUP.md`](docs/DSH-0.2.1-RC1-FOLLOWUP.md)；本轮的实测依据、复现脚本与仍待决策项见 [`docs/DSH-0.2.2-RC1-FOLLOWUP.md`](docs/DSH-0.2.2-RC1-FOLLOWUP.md)。

- PAT 只写入本地插件配置（或环境变量），**从不进入任何网络请求**；对外请求一律使用 cosy 会话令牌（jobToken）+ 机器指纹头。
- 本地 shim 用随机端口的 loopback 服务 + 进程内 secret 鉴权，并校验 Host / Origin / Content-Type，请求体有 64MB 上限。
- 本插件只读你显式提供的 PAT；**不读取、不修改** Qoder 桌面端的本地登录/凭据文件。
- 诊断输出（`doctor` / `status` 与卡片探测）均脱敏，不打印任何令牌样式的字符串。

本插件声明了可安装的 `dsh.bundle` manifest（`dsh.bundle.patch: ./cordis.patch.yml`），因此可以用 `dsh plugin add` 安装。社区市场通常从 [Awesome DSH Plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 注册表同步条目；仓库内的提交草稿位于 [`awesome-dsh-plugin-submission/dingminhua__dsh-connect-qoder.yml`](awesome-dsh-plugin-submission/dingminhua__dsh-connect-qoder.yml)。

dsh-connect-qoder

Connect Qoder (Lingma CN / international) models to DeepSeek Harness, with an account pool, daily check-in, credit readouts and model management.
中文 · Installation · How it works · Configuration · Account pool · Changelog · Issues

A standalone [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) bundle plugin. It connects your Qoder account's models to the DSH model picker, with an account pool, daily check-in, credit readouts and model management. **The CN and international editions are two parallel providers (`qoder` / `qoder-global`) that can be used at the same time**; the plugin's settings page separates them with tabs.

> Qoder does not expose an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (its official SDK is only an agent launcher), so this plugin talks to Qoder's cosy gateway directly, implementing a minimal client for the protocol. No Qoder desktop sign-in is needed — just a PAT (Personal Access Token).

- **Two parallel providers (CN + international)** — the CN edition registers as the `qoder` provider (`gateway.qoder.com.cn`); the international edition registers as `qoder-global` (`api1.qoder.sh`). **Regions with a PAT configured show their models in the DSH model picker**: with a PAT for both regions you get two groups that can be used simultaneously and independently per session. **A region without a PAT lists no models** (no request could succeed, so listing them would only invite failures); configure a PAT and hit "Refresh models" to make them appear — the provider itself stays registered; the configuration entry point is **Settings → Qoder**. Model names embed the upstream credit multiplier (e.g. `Qwen3.8-Flash · x0.00`), matching Qoder's own model menu.

- **Settings card tabs** — the card top has "CN / Global" tabs, each with its own PAT, account pool, model management and credits; catalogs, selections and state stay fully isolated per tab. - **Accounts / Models / Diagnostics sections** — under each region tab the body is split into three sections. *Accounts* holds the pool, the credit-readout switches and every notice about the credential (each lands on the click); *Models* holds the checkboxes, context tiers, reasoning strengths and per-model tests (a draft until you press Save) — the two commit differently, so splitting them puts the save button next to what it saves. **Switching sections never refetches and never drops an unsaved draft** (inactive sections stay mounted). *Diagnostics* is a read-only fact table: region, **upstream domain** (the same single fact the real requests use), serving account, credential source, when credits were read, catalog size, enabled count, pool switch, and upstream's own last error **verbatim** — it exists to be

- **Promotion badge** — upstream ships the promotion rule inside the model catalog itself (`promotion`: label, window, time zone), so each row paints a small capsule next to the model name, e.g. `Off-Peak 60% off`. **The label is upstream's own text** (Chinese UI reads `badge.zh`, English UI `badge.en`); the plugin neither translates nor rewrites it. Hover shows upstream's description, the window and time zone, and the campaign link as plain text. Whether it paints is decided **at render time**: when upstream declares a wall-clock window (midnight-crossing supported, evaluated in upstream's own time zone) that window alone decides, and only a rule without a window falls back to upstream's `active` flag — so a catalog fetched at night cannot freeze the badge until the next morning, and a process started in the morning still shows it that night; models without a promotion field paint nothing. The same badge also renders in the host's **

- **Per-model availability probe** — every model row has a "Test" button that goes straight to upstream: rate-limited (429) → "Rate limited", invalid credential → "Invalid credential", content-policy rejection → "Blocked by content policy", quota exhausted → "Quota exhausted", and other upstream transient failures are classified honestly. Probes run in the background, **credentials never reach the page**; results are not written into settings and do not change your saved selections. **Probes are real requests** (they consume a small amount of upstream credit), so they are per-model and manual only — there is no batch "test all checked" button. - **Daily check-in** — Qoder runs an official daily check-in campaign (individual users claim 100 credits a day, valid for 30 days). - **CLI diagnostics** — `dsh-connect-qoder doctor|status|logout [--json] [--region cn|global]`: `doctor` reports PAT source, cosy fingerprint derivation, pi-ai generation, host heartbeat liveness, and vault account counts; `status` reports credential source, upstream reachability, and remaining credits; `logout` clears a region's vault accounts and pool measurements. No browser needed.

```text
DSH PiAiAdapter (one set per provider)
  -> secure loopback shim (random port + in-process secret per region)
  -> QoderUpstreamClient (minimal cosy-protocol client)
  -> CN      https://gateway.qoder.com.cn/algo/api/v2/...

The CN and international editions each own a full runtime stack — upstream client, model catalog, loopback shim, adapter — isolated by region configuration (gateway / openapi / catalog paths), so **models from both regions can be available at the same time and used by different sessions**.

Credentials are PATs (settings page `regions.<region>.pat`, or environment variables — see [Configuration](#configuration)); the settings value wins. Sessions lazily exchange a **jobToken** on demand: the PAT is used once in that exchange, and every subsequent request carries a cosy bearer (custom Base64 payload + MD5 signature) plus "machine fingerprint" session headers. **The PAT never reaches pi-ai and never leaves the process except in that one local exchange; this plugin neither reads nor writes Qoder desktop sign-in files.**

Encoding and signing details (custom alphabet, `n/3` rearrangement, `cosy&<SECRET>&<date>` signature, RSA/AES session wrapping) are documented at the top of `src/cosy.ts`; the error taxonomy (content policy / rate limit / quota exhausted / transient) and how it maps onto DSH retry semantics live in `src/upstream.ts`.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @dmh2002/dsh-connect-qoder   # Desktop
dsh plugin --profile web add @dmh2002/dsh-connect-qoder       # Web
```

Then **restart that profile's DSH process** (the host half of a bundle loads at startup). You can also search for `dsh-connect-qoder` in DSH's "Plugin market / Bundles" and install it in one click.

Repoint the shim at the CLI entry the new host ships:

> That entry runs `dsh/lib/bin.js` inside `app.asar` via `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`; the profile is still chosen with `--profile`.

The plugin's **configuration identity inside DSH does not** — the settings namespace, the `/plugins/dsh-connect-qoder/…` routes and the CLI program name all stay `dsh-connect-qoder`, so anyone upgrading from 0.2.0 keeps their saved configuration with no need to re-enter PATs. The settings page's addressing no longer depends on the package name either: it is a `settings.section` keyed by the **unscoped** entry id. - Open Settings (the gear in the sidebar, or `Cmd/Ctrl + ,`) → the **Qoder** row at the bottom of the left nav → the configuration page appears with its CN / Global tabs.
- `pnpm exec dsh-connect-qoder doctor`, run inside that profile directory, should print both regions' PAT status and fingerprint derivation.
- After configuring a PAT, "Refresh from Qoder" should fetch the region's real catalog; the model picker shows `Qoder` / `Qoder Global` groups.

Create a PAT (`pt-…`) in your Qoder account settings. Two ways to provide it — **the settings page wins over the environment variable**:

| Region | Where to issue it | Setting | Environment variable |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CN (qoder.com.cn) | Console → Settings → API Tokens | Card "CN" tab → Add PAT | `QODERCN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN` |
| Global (qoder.sh) | Console → Settings → Personal Access Tokens | Card "Global" tab → Add PAT | `QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN` |

- The PAT is stored only in the local plugin configuration (`regions.<region>.pat`); it is never uploaded and never enters any network request.
- A region without a PAT lists no models; the `doctor` command points out which region is missing one.
- **Step-by-step walkthrough in [`docs/PAT.md`](docs/PAT.md)** (issuing, verification, precedence, troubleshooting).

The checkbox on each tab controls whether that region participates in the model picker (opt-out: **only an explicit uncheck disables it**). Disabling only removes the route and the directory entries; configuration is kept.

The card's Accounts section carries a row, "Show Qoder in the sidebar": tick it and DSH's sidebar gains a Qoder icon row that opens **this same card as a full page** (the same account pool, model catalog and diagnostics, filling the centre column), with a "Back to conversation" button in its header.

- **Off by default, and an explicit opt-in.** That row claims `sidebar.panellist` — the **global sidebar seat every installed plugin shares** — and opening it takes over the centre panel, so turning it on is a decision about your whole sidebar rather than a preference about this page. Settings → Qoder already reaches the same content, so anyone who never ticked it sees **no change at all after upgrading**.
- **It takes effect on the click — no save needed.** Switching it off while the page is open returns the centre column to the conversation by itself (the host drops a `main` selection whose key no longer exists).
- Stored as the top-level `sidebarPanel` setting (**no region axis**: one row, one page, unrelated to CN / global). It therefore still opens when a region is signed out — or when both are switched off — since the panel is one of the places you go to add a first PAT.
- The test is `=== true`: absent, `false`, and a hand-edited string `"true"` all read as off.

Besides the settings PAT and the environment variable, each region has a local vault (`$DSH_HOME/.qoder-accounts.<region>.json`, mode 0600) that stores multiple PAT accounts. The three sources are merged de-duplicated by **settings → env → vault** (a PAT appearing in two sources is listed once, under the higher-priority source).

- The card can add (paste a `pt-…`, validated via a `JobToken` exchange that returns the display name; you may also set your own label) and rename vault accounts, and can pin a specific account to serve (`regions.<region>.accountId`, empty = automatic). Deleting a vault account is the pool table's per-row **Delete** button (which asks once before it acts); unticking and saving only takes it out of rotation.
- The selected credential is used only for the session's jobToken exchange and subsequent cosy requests — it never reaches pi-ai or the page.
- `logout [--region cn|global]` clears that region's vault accounts and pool measurements (`.qoder-accounts.<region>.json` and `.qoder-pool.<region>.json`).
- Membership, the batch actions, and the failover rules are covered in the [Account pool](#account-pool) section.

One machine often holds several Qoder accounts (several PATs). The **account pool** collapses that into single clicks: check accounts into the pool, then "Check in all accounts" or "Test all accounts"; switch on **Enable account pool** and the plugin automatically fails over to another account when a request fails upstream.

**Each region (CN / international) has its own pool**: members, target model, credits and check-in state never cross over — the accounts belong to different providers anyway. **Both regions have daily check-in**: the international campaign is only served to requests carrying device-risk headers, which the plugin obtains from the device-identity component shipped by the local Qoder client; if it cannot be read, the plugin reports that honestly instead of silently degrading to "no campaign today".

readme.section: Automatic failover (enabled together with the pool)
readme.text:
- **Ranking decides who serves**: with the pool on, **every request** goes to the top-ranked usable account, so "currently serving" may not be the account you pinned.
- **Failures walk down the list**: when a request fails upstream, the plugin retries the next usable accounts **in order**, until one takes over or all are exhausted — only then is the error surfaced.
- **What triggers a switch**: 429 rate limits, exhausted quota, rejected credentials (401/403), 5xx gateway/network failures — those are per-account states.
- **What does not**: an invalid request (HTTP 400) — the same body fails identically for everyone, so retrying only makes you wait; and a stream that has already started is never replayed (bytes are on the wire).
- **Known-bad accounts are skipped**: members inside a rate-limit cooldown or with a credential the upstream rejected do not participate. **Never-tested accounts count as usable by default** — a freshly added account should not be excluded because nobody pressed "Test" yet.
- **Your manual choice is never rewritten**: the pool overrides routing at runtime and never writes back your saved selection; turning the switch off restores your pinned account immediat

| | Pool **on** | Pool **off** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Who serves | chosen **automatically** by ranking (usable → expiring credits → soonest credit expiry → most credits → id) | the account **you** pick under "Which account to use" in the settings area |
| Request fails | retries the next usable account **automatically** | no switch; the error is reported as-is |
| Check in all / Test all | available | **still available** |
| Target test model | editable | **still editable** |

The last two rows are deliberate: checking in and testing are **manual actions** on the members you selected — a different question from whether the plugin routes automatically.

**The one hard rule**: with zero members checked, batch actions refuse outright. An empty pool never degrades into "then run it on all accounts" — that would be the one reading that spends credits you did not authorize.

The host has an in-place retry loop: when a request fails but is worth one more attempt, it waits and sends it again. The wait ladder is declared by the plugin and executed by the host; by default it follows the host, so leaving it unset keeps your behaviour exactly as it is today.

Qoder occasionally answers with `RESOURCE_LIMIT` (business code `10605`) and **states how long to wait**. The plugin now writes that value into the failure text it hands the host (of the form `[upstream retry-after 5s]`), so you can see that upstream only asked for five seconds instead of just "upstream returned a 4xx".

To change the budget, set these numbers (per region):

```yaml
regions:
  cn:
    retry:
      maxRetries: 4        # attempts (0 = follow the host default)

`5000 -> 30000` covers both common upstream shapes: a transient throttle (5 s) and a `queueType:p2` queue (about 30 s). **The first three zeros mean "follow the host default"**, so leaving them out is equivalent to not configuring this at all; the fourth one, `queueWaitMs: 0`, turns that feature **off** (see below).

> Previously this was whatever the host picked; changing it meant editing the build artifact inside `node_modules` — and that silently reverts on upgrade.

readme.section: Waiting out a queue yourself (`queueWaitMs`, issue #29)
readme.text: **The retry budget cannot cover "upstream explicitly asked us to wait 30 seconds".** The host's ladder is increasing (5 s -> 10 s -> 20 s -> 30 s, with jitter), so its first two attempts are **always** shorter than the 30 seconds upstream asked for. Measured in the wild: one turn took 28 retries and 296 seconds of pure waiting, and 11 of those attempts fired within 5 seconds of upstream saying "wait 30 seconds".

readme.section: Waiting out a queue yourself (`queueWaitMs`, issue #29)
readme.text: The plugin cannot make the host wait precisely: the `pi-ai` route has no `providerRetryAfterMs` channel (re-checked in issue #24 — `retry-after` appears in neither that module nor the vendor underneath it). So waiting in the forwarding layer is the only way to make "wait 30 seconds" actually mean 30 seconds without spending the host's retry budget:

readme.section: Waiting out a queue yourself (`queueWaitMs`, issue #29)
Two kinds of "queued" must not be conflated (issue #29)
readme.text: The same `isQueued: true` has two shapes, and the plugin words them and accounts for them differently:

readme.section: Two kinds of "queued" must not be conflated (issue #29)
readme.text:
| Upstream field | Meaning | What the plugin does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `isQueued:true` + `serviceAvailable:true` | the service is fine, you are in the queue (`queueCount` is usually > 0) | recorded as **queued**, cooled down for the stated duration; switching accounts is meaningful |
| `isQueued:true` + `serviceAvailable:false` | upstream is **refusing service overall** (measured `queueCount: 0` — nobody is in the queue) | recorded as **upstream unavailable**; the switch notice says outright that this is not the account's fault |

readme.section: Two kinds of "queued" must not be conflated (issue #29)
readme.text: The difference matters: for the first, "wait a bit" or "use another account" works; for the second, switching accounts — and switching PAT — does **not**. Measured: 14 models unavailable at once. Both shapes used to be reported as "queued", so users went off to re-provision their credentials for no reason.

readme.section: Ranking rules (who serves when the pool is on)
Ranking rules (who serves when the pool is on)
readme.text: ⚠️ **Plan expiry takes no part in ranking** (issue #31): that date answers "how long can this account keep working", which is not the same question as "will credits sitting on it lapse". Treating it as urgency would pin an account whose trial just ended to the front forever — while none of its credits will ever expire.

- **Check in all accounts** — claims the daily campaign per account. **Status is read before claiming**, so an already-claimed day is marked "checked in" without a write request (idempotent, no double claim); a failure on one account marks that row and **never aborts the batch**. Claiming changes balances, so the region's usage cache is invalidated when the batch ends.
- **Test all accounts** — one real request per member, answering "can this account use this model right now". The target model defaults to "automatic": a multiplier-0 free model in that region (largest context wins ties). You may pin one — but **testing stays disabled until a free model appears**, so credits are never spent without you knowing. Tests share the per-model probe, so they **have a real cost**.

**The test target is independent of your enabled models** (issue #33): ticking a model decides what the DSH model picker lists, not what may be tested. Whatever the card says is the target is what a test actually probes — even if that model is not ticked under enabled models, and even when the only free model in the region is unticked. These two catalogs used to be separate (the card read the full one, the test route read a runtime one trimmed to the enabled set), and the symptom was a button that did nothing: the card said "test target qfmodel" while a click returned an empty result. There is exactly one catalog now.

When the target genuinely cannot be resolved (no free model in the catalog at all, or the pinned model is gone), the route answers `409` with a reason (`no-free-model` / `target-model-stale`) and the card says "no testable target model" — instead of replying with something that reads like a broken account.

readme.section: What the plugin does when the upstream states no recovery time (issue #32)
readme.text:
Two states look alike and are completely different:

| | Meaning | Decided by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `retryAtMs` present | "the upstream says this account works again after that moment" | an upstream field, a reset sentence in the failure body, or **derived** from the daily check-in window (`retrySource` tells you which) |
| `retrySource: 'unknown-cooldown'` | "the upstream said nothing, the snapshot has nothing; we are retrying **every 30 minutes** on our own" | the plugin |

readme.section: What the plugin does when the upstream states no recovery time (issue #32)
readme.text: These two used to be indistinguishable in the data: with `retryAtMs` absent the card went silent, which reads exactly like "the upstream said nothing and nothing will be retried" — while in fact the pool was about to hit the upstream with **one real chat request** every 30 minutes. The fallback branch now writes `retrySource: 'unknown-cooldown'`, and the card says "the upstream gave no time for when this frees up · Retrying automatically about every 30 min". It writes **only the source, never `retryAtMs`** — that field keeps carrying upstream/derived moments only; putting our own cadence there would make the next reader believe the upstream promised a time.

readme.section: What the plugin does when the upstream states no recovery time (issue #32)
readme.text: **The 30-minute number is deliberately unchanged**: the official wording is only "continue the next day after the daily quota is used up", with no specific moment, so inventing 6 hours is exactly as arbitrary as inventing 30 minutes. What actually lowers the cost is the next point.

readme.section: The check-in window moment is persisted, so a restart no longer forces the fallback
readme.text: The recovery point for `110` (daily usage limit) comes from the `endAt` of the check-in campaign row. That snapshot used to live only inside the process — and the fallback cooldown is precisely what applies when "the window moment is unknown", so **every restart made the fallback apply**, and an account that has to wait for tomorrow's window got probed every 30 minutes.

readme.text: The window moment of a successful check-in is now written to the `windows` key of `$DSH_HOME/.qoder-pool.<region>.json` and read back after a restart (the in-process snapshot wins, disk is the fallback; **a moment already in the past is not used** — using an old date as "when it recovers" would keep the account out of the pool long after the upstream recovered). This is what turns the fallback from "usually applies" into "almost never applies" — far more useful than tuning that 30-minute number.

- The PAT is stored only in the local plugin configuration (or an environment variable) and **never enters any network request**; external calls always use cosy session tokens (jobToken) plus machine-fingerprint headers.
- The local shim is a random-port loopback service with an in-process secret, verifying Host / Origin / Content-Type, with a 64 MB request-body cap.
- The plugin only reads PATs you explicitly provide; it **never reads or modifies** Qoder desktop sign-in/credential files.
- Diagnostic output (`doctor` / `status` and card probes) is redacted and never prints token-like strings.
